evaluation_criteria.title: Minimum Qualification Requirements

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory pass/fail subcriterion. Proponents must confirm experience conducting at least ten (10) facilitation engagements within the last three (3) years involving executive teams, senior leadership teams, or cross-functional groups.

source_refs.excerpt: Facilitation Experience: Proponents must confirm that they have experience conducting at least ten (10) facilitation engagements within the last three (3) years involving executive teams, senior leadership teams, or cross-functional groups.

evaluation_criteria.title: Facilitation Experience

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory pass/fail subcriterion. Proponents must confirm completion of at least three (3) team-effectiveness or strategic planning engagements within the last three (3) years that included facilitated workshops and documented outcomes or action plans.
